When I'm in a low stretch, I don't have any of that unstoppable energy, though I do sometimes pace or fidget out of frustration because I feel so stuck and slow.\n\nDoctor: During your high-energy periods, do you ever also have any depressive symptoms like feeling hopeless, guilty, or losing interest at the same time? And during your low periods, do you ever still feel unusually energized, restless, or need much less sleep?\n\nPatient: They are completely separate for me. When I'm on a high streak, I feel on top of the world, extremely motivated, and confident, with no hopeless feelings at all. When I'm low, I just feel totally wiped out and exhausted, rather than energized, even if I sometimes pace around because I'm frustrated at how slow I'm moving.\n\nDoctor: During your high-energy periods, did you ever hear or see things that other people couldn’t, or believe things that others thought were clearly untrue?\n\nPatient: No, I didn't experience anything like that during my high periods either. I have never heard or seen things that weren't actually there, and I've never held any beliefs that other people found completely untrue or impossible.\n\nDoctor: During your high-energy periods, do you also have any depressive symptoms like feeling hopeless, guilty, or losing interest at the same time? When I'm in a low stretch, I don't have any of that unstoppable energy, though I do sometimes pace or fidget out of frustration because I feel so stuck and slow.\n\nDoctor: During your high-energy periods, do you ever also have any depressive symptoms like feeling hopeless, guilty, or losing interest at the same time? And during your low periods, do you ever still feel unusually energized, restless, or need much less sleep?\n\nPatient: They are completely separate for me. When I'm on a high streak, I feel on top of the world, extremely motivated, and confident, with no hopeless feelings at all. When I'm low, I just feel totally wiped out and exhausted, rather than energized, even if I sometimes pace around because I'm frustrated at how slow I'm moving.\n\nDoctor: During your high-energy periods, did you ever hear or see things that other people couldn’t, or believe things that others thought were clearly untrue?\n\nPatient: No, I didn't experience anything like that during my high periods either. I never heard or saw things that weren't real, and I didn't hold any beliefs that were completely out of touch with reality.\n\nDoctor: Has your current low mood and loss of interest been present nearly every day for at least 2 weeks, or has it been shorter or intermittent?\n\nPatient: Yes, it has been present nearly every single day, not intermittent at all. This heavy, exhausted stretch has been hanging over me consistently for about three months now, making it really hard to work or even do basic things around the apartment.\n\nDoctor: During your high-energy or low periods, have you ever had hallucinations or strongly believed things that others said were not true? This would help determine whether the episodes had psychotic features.\n\nPatient: No, I have never experienced seeing or hearing things that aren't actually there, during either my high or low periods. I also haven't held any beliefs that others told me were completely untrue.\n\nDoctor: During your high-energy or low periods, have you ever had hallucinations or strongly believed things that others said were not true? This would help determine whether the episodes had psychotic features.\n\nPatient: No, I’ve never seen or heard things that weren't there, and I didn't believe anything completely unreal. The closest thing was just being extremely overconfident about my business plans during my high periods, thinking I could easily launch a whole food truck chain in a year. But there were definitely no hallucinations or anything like that.\n\nDoctor: During your high or low episodes, have you ever had hallucinations or beliefs that were clearly not true, like thinking others were trying to harm you or that you had special powers?\n\nPatient: No, I've never experienced anything like that. I never believed I had actual supernatural or special powers, and I never felt like people were trying to harm me. It was really just a massive boost in my regular confidence, not anything out of touch with reality.\n\nDoctor: Right now, do you feel mainly depressed and slowed down, or are you also having the high-energy symptoms again like needing much less sleep, racing thoughts, or feeling unusually confident?\n\nPatient: Right now, and for the last three months, I am definitely stuck in the low, slowed-down phase. I also talked constantly and jumped from topic to topic so fast that others couldn't get a word in, to the point where I felt physically uncomfortable if there was any silence.\n\nDoctor: During this low period, have you had any thoughts that you would be better off dead, or any thoughts of harming yourself?\n\nPatient: No, I haven't had any thoughts of wanting to die or hurting myself at all. I just feel completely exhausted and drained of all my energy, like I'm running on empty every single day.\n\nDoctor: Have your current low symptoms lasted at least 2 weeks continuously, or have they been shorter than that?\n\nPatient: Yes, they have lasted much longer than two weeks. The whole cycle of going from feeling unstoppable to completely drained started about four months ago when I began working extra double shifts, and this current low stretch has been going on for about three months.\n\nDoctor: Before this current low period, have you ever had any other episodes of depression or a long stretch of feeling down and losing interest that lasted at least 2 weeks?\n\nPatient: No, I haven't ever had another low period like this before. This current stretch, which hit me after my high period a few months ago, is the very first time I've ever felt this down and drained.\n\nDoctor: Have you ever had any prior manic, hypomanic, or major depressive episodes before this past 4 months, even if they were milder or shorter?\n\nPatient: No, I haven't really experienced anything like this before this recent four-month period. This helps tell whether this is a first episode or a recurring mood disorder.\n\nPatient: No, I haven't really experienced periods like this before these past four months. This is the very first time my mood and energy have ever swung so dramatically.\n\nDoctor: Have these mood episodes been happening for at least a year, or did they only start within the last few months?\n\nPatient: They only started within the last few months. The back-and-forth mood swings have been happening for about four months, starting when I took on extra double shifts at the restaurant. This heavy, low phase has been going on for about three months of that time.\n\nDoctor: Have you ever had any similar episodes of high energy or depression before these last few months, even if they were shorter or milder?\n\nPatient: No, I don't recall ever having episodes like this before. All of these intense ups and downs really just started about four months ago when I began working those extra double shifts at the restaurant.\n\nDoctor: Have these mood episodes been happening for at least 1 year, or did they only start within the last few months?"
